title: Source inventory section cards
summary: This iteration turns the full source inventory overview into seven fixed source section cards while preserving all 154 collection entries in expanded detail groups.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory overview renders fixed section cards" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory overview renders fixed section cards|source inventory panel|source inventory navigation|source inventory density controls|source inventory section cards" tests/unit.test.js
node --test --test-name-pattern "effective-interact renders source inventory finder" tests/skills.test.js

lessons.lesson: The full inventory needs a visible section overview before the long expanded list.
lessons.evidence: `source-inventory` now emits an effective-interact `filterable-cards` section with `source-inventory-section-card` cards for seven fixed source sections, while detail groups keep every collection entry expanded below.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep new inventory navigation affordances on the fixed section-card contract instead of reintroducing dense overview tables.

lessons.lesson: Finder behavior must stay non-hiding after the overview changes type.
lessons.evidence: `renderFilterableCards` renders the source inventory finder when `sourceInventoryFinder` is set, and the browser smoke proved WeChat search highlights 4/154 rows while hiding zero rows.
lessons.recommended_action: Any future source inventory search or grouping control should preserve highlight-only behavior unless the user explicitly asks for hiding or filtering.

lessons.lesson: Presentation changes can expose source importance without changing collection or ranking contracts.
lessons.evidence: The implementation keeps source registry, source display contract ranks, collection, ranking, automation, Pages, credentials, and publish commands untouched; source display validation still checks 154 inventory sources.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue separating source acquisition/ranking changes from public presentation refinements.

followups.action: Use the next phase to tune the first-screen source story and metrics relationship without changing the fixed source inventory ordering.
